_what: The day-off animations, by the link Green-API holds them at. The files themselves are not here on purpose: they are somebody else's work and this repository is public.
_how_to_add:
Send the animation to the school's WhatsApp number from any phone, then re-upload it through the gateway once and keep the link it hands back:
  curl -X POST -F "chatId=50769027049@c.us" -F "file=@it.mp4" "$GREENAPI_URL/waInstance$GREENAPI_ID/sendFileByUpload/$GREENAPI_TOKEN"
The reply carries urlFile. Paste it below with a word about what it is.
_how_to_send: python3 send.py --to +<number> --text greeting.txt --url <the url>. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is downloaded first -- the file went over once, and every night after that is a single call.
_if_a_link_dies: Send the greeting as text. A day off wished plainly beats silence, and a broken picture is worse than no picture.
_note: Two is thin. Four or five and nobody sees the same one twice in a fortnight.
